author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: The current drawing was a ring over a pill bar on a stem and read as a Korean glyph or a signpost. It had no cradle sides. Redrawn after the reference: a basket between two tall corner posts, with top and bottom rails, standing on a long rocker whose ends curl up, and the baby's round head peeking above the top rail.
omissions: The basket's rounded bowl bottom and the baby's shoulders were dropped. A bowl can't meet the posts and rocker at 8-unit spacing.
